title: Zone Vocabulary v1
description: Schema for the zone vocabulary artifact describing groupings of zone-related strings extracted from game assets.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this vocabulary was generated

source_inventory.description: Filename of the source inventory JSON used to produce this vocabulary

total_zone_entries.description: Total number of zone entries across all groups

total_inspected_payloads.description: Total number of asset payloads inspected during vocabulary generation

groups.description: Grouped vocabulary entries, each keyed by a common string that ties the entries together

group_key.description: Primary string that groups these entries together

entry_count.description: Number of entries in this group

zone_names.description: Zone names associated with this group (e.g. Freemarch, Stillmoor)

map_keys.description: Map key identifiers referenced in this group

file_paths.description: File paths within game assets related to this group

shader_references.description: Shader variable or parameter names referenced by this group

other_strings.description: Miscellaneous strings that did not fit other categories

entries.description: Raw asset entries belonging to this group

archive.description: Archive file the entry originates from

entry_index.description: Index of the entry within its archive

type.description: Binary type of the entry (e.g. bin, txt, png)

all_unique_strings.description: Deduplicated list of every unique string collected across all groups

classification_counts.description: Count of unique strings per classification category

zone_names.description: Number of unique zone name strings

map_keys.description: Number of unique map key strings

file_paths.description: Number of unique file path strings

shader_references.description: Number of unique shader reference strings

other.description: Number of unique strings classified as other
